plumbing.review:
- **P2: Trusted-file details can defeat comment clipping.** [plancomments.go:143](plancomments.go:143) puts retry guidance—including the complete trusted-file list—into the protected closing text. [comments.go:48](comments.go:48) clips only the body. A valid plan with enough long trusted paths can therefore exceed GitHub’s comment limit even after clipping, preventing publication of the failure and its instructions. Keep file details in the clippable body or bound them separately.

Otherwise, the changes match the plan, preserve behavior and safeguards, and follow surrounding idioms. Acceptance sources are unchanged; the factory reports all checks passing. No new network, host, or secret access found. Browser behavior was reviewed statically.

VERDICT: changes needed — bound trusted-file details in protected closing text and add a clipping regression test.
